sloka: मन्त्रिणो यत्र निरस्तास् तम् आहुर् मन्त्रम् उत्तमम् ।बह्व्यो अपि मतयो गत्वा मन्त्रिणो हि अर्थ निर्णये ॥६-६-१३॥।।
transliteration: mantriṇo yatra nirastās tam āhur mantram uttamam ।bahvyo api matayo gatvā mantriṇo hi artha nirṇaye ॥6-6-13॥।।

translations.english: "The conclusion in which many ministers have different points of view and attain unanimity in decision after meeting different points of view is a mediocre vision."
